opening_message: ORD-7228 finally arrived four days late. The shoes are fine, but I want compensation for the delay.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to late-delivery compensation for ORD-7228; the shoes arrived four days late and you are not trying to return, replace, or exchange them.
Provide the order ID when asked, and provide the four-day delay and undamaged condition only when asked or needed to correct the agent's path.
If the agent starts a damaged-item return, replacement, or exchange path, decline and clarify that the shoes are fine and you only want compensation for the delay.
Push back if the agent denies compensation without checking the late-delivery policy or proposes any action that would change the order or item status.
If compensation is previewed as store credit or the method is unclear, ask for it to go back to original payment.
Accept only a $15 late-delivery compensation preview to original payment with no return, replacement, exchange, or label created.
End only after the agent confirms the $15 original-payment compensation has been processed and the shoes remain kept as delivered.
